title: OpenTela-Hetero capability profile, version 1
description: What one computer reports about its hardware. Every field has a reason (see week5/day04/schema-notes.md).

schema_version.description: Shape version, so readers know which rules apply if the shape changes later.

collected_at.description: H3: when this was measured, in UTC, so readers can tell how old it is.

source.description: Honesty: where the numbers came from.

mode.description: live = read from the real machine now; fixture = read from a saved capture file.

tool.description: Which program gave the GPU numbers.

fixture_file.description: Which saved file was used (only for fixture mode).

arch.description: H1: a program built for one architecture fails on another (Exec format error). Go names only: amd64 not x86_64, arm64 not aarch64.

gpu_status.description: Why the GPU list looks the way it does. ok = tool ran and found GPUs; none_found = tool ran and found zero; tool_missing = tool not installed, so we cannot be sure; query_failed = tool exists but gave an error.

gpu_error.description: The error text when gpu_status is tool_missing or query_failed, so a person can see why.

gpus.description: One entry per GPU card. Empty when gpu_status is not ok.

vendor.description: H1: CUDA jobs need NVIDIA. OpenTela also tries AMD (rocm-smi, gpu.go:49).

name.description: OpenTela already has this field (GPUSpec.Name). Readable in the report.

memory_total_mib.description: H2: free memory = total - used. Whole number, MiB.

memory_used_mib.description: H2: busy or not. Changes all the time, so it can get old (H3). Whole number, MiB.

compute_capability.description: H1: a job may need a minimum GPU generation. Text like 12.0, not a number. null = not available.

driver_version.description: H1 candidate: an old driver may not run new CUDA jobs. RQ4 may show it is not needed. null = not available.

uuid_short.description: Day 3: which physical card. Only GPU- plus 8 characters, never the full uuid. null = not available.

pci_bus_id.description: Day 3: which slot. Backup ID when there is no uuid. null = not available.
